title: Siman 424
section: Fleeing from Philosophical Inquiry and Strengthening in Faith

segments.he: פַּעַם אַחַתיָשַׁב יַחַד עִם הָרַב הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַמַּגִּיד מִטֶּירָאוִיצֶע, כִּמְדֻמֶּה שֶׁהָיָה בִּסְעֻדָּה שְׁלִישִׁית שֶׁל שַׁבָּת,
segments.en: (18.) Regarding the matter of the Shemittos [cosmic cycles] — that there are Kabbalistic books that hold this opinion as is explained in the books — Rabbainu o.b.m. said that this is not so etc. And also the view of the Ari of blessed memory does not agree at all with the matter of the Shemittos etc.
